highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 reduces allocations in pixel and text-processing paths while fixing front-buffered stream retention.
highlights_body: Managed pixel copies and HarfBuzz text operations avoid temporary allocations without changing their results. Disposed front-buffered streams now release borrowed source streams.

bullets.detail: Valid managed pixel buffers now copy directly into raster images instead of first creating an intermediate SKData instance, while invalid-input behavior remains unchanged.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz text operations avoid temporary buffers
bullets.detail: UTF-32 buffer input and feature-string formatting now reuse or stack-allocate their encoding buffers while preserving existing HarfBuzz results.

bullets.lead: Disposed front-buffered streams release borrowed streams
bullets.detail: SKFrontBufferedManagedStream no longer retains an underlying stream after disposal when it does not own that stream.
